reconstruction_summary: Re-implemented agent's V1: stock KS yaw-rate (v/L)*tan(delta) with per-segment straight-line bias removal (mean residual where |delta_road|<0.01), using each platform's openpilot-canonical wheelbase L.
notes: V1 applies per-segment straight-line yaw-gyro bias (mean of pred-meas where |delta_road|<0.01) — fitted in-sample on each canonical segment, matching the agent's loop. Wheelbase L is per-platform (Mach-E 2.984 m, Lightning 3.70 m). The agent originally fit V1 on 25 Mach-E segments; here it is applied to all 545 Ford segments (both platforms).
